title_zh: WINTEX项目团队紧急驰援助力菲律宾Alabat岛渡轮修复 保障社区出行
title_en: WINTEX Project Team Provides Emergency Support to Restore Ferry Operations on Alabat Island, Philippines
content_zh: 日期：2025年11月 菲律宾·奎松省Alabat岛 2025年11月，超强台风“凤凰”（Typhoon Fenghuang）袭击菲律宾沿岸地区，给当地民生与基础设施造成严重影响。位于台风路径上的Alabat岛受灾尤为明显，岛上主要载客渡轮在狂风巨浪中与临时码头发生碰撞，船体受损，岛内交通一度中断，居民出行受到严重影响。 快速响应地方需求，第一时间投入抢修 在Alabat岛地方政府发出紧急求助后，WINTEX Alabat项目团队迅速响应，第一时间调集现场可用的重型吊装设备及专业人员，与当地技术力量协同配合，立即投入受损渡轮的应急修复工作。 面对复杂海况、受限作业条件及时间压力，项目团队在确保作业安全的前提下，连续开展船体扶正、结构加固等关键工序，有效缩短抢修周期，为渡轮尽快恢复运行创造了条件。 工程能力服务民生，保障岛民“生命线”畅通 经过紧张有序的抢修作业，受损渡轮在最短时间内恢复了基本运行能力，岛内交通秩序逐步恢复。渡轮作为Alabat岛居民日常通行的重要交通工具，其及时修复对于保障岛民基本出行、医疗与物资运输具有重要意义。 此次应急行动，不仅体现了WINTEX项目团队在复杂环境下的工程执行能力，也展现了公司在突发情况下的快速协调与现场决策能力。 获得当地政府与社区的高度认可 WINTEX项目团队的及时支援与专业表现，获得了Alabat岛地方政府及社区居民的高度评价。当地社区代表表示，WINTEX在关键时刻主动伸出援手，其专业能力与责任意识令人深受感动。 扎根项目所在地，践行企业社会责任 WINTEX始终秉持“扎根当地、共创价值”的理念。在推进工程项目建设的同时，公司高度重视与项目所在地社区的协同发展，积极履行企业社会责任。 未来，WINTEX将继续以专业能力服务项目建设，同时与当地政府和社区保持紧密合作，为区域的长期稳定与可持续发展贡献力量。
content_en: Date: November 2025 Alabat Island, Quezon Province, Philippines In November 2025, Super Typhoon Fenghuang struck coastal areas of the Philippines, causing significant damage to local communities and infrastructure. Alabat Island, located along the typhoon’s path, was among the hardest-hit areas. During the storm, a passenger ferry serving the island collided with a temporary jetty, sustaining structural damage and disrupting the island’s primary transportation link. Rapid Response to Local Emergency Needs Following an urgent request from the local government of Alabat Island, the WINTEX Alabat Project Team responded immediately. Heavy lifting equipment and technical personnel available on site were promptly mobilized, working closely with local technicians to carry out emergency repair operations on the damaged ferry. Despite challenging sea conditions and a constrained working environment, the WINTEX team safely and efficiently executed critical repair tasks, including vessel stabilization and structural reinforcement, enabling the ferry to regain operational capability within a short timeframe. Engineering Expertise Supporting Community Connectivity The timely restoration of the ferry played a vital role in reconnecting the island’s transportation network. As a key mode of daily transport for residents, the ferry’s return to service helped ensure access to essential services, including medical transport and the delivery of basic supplies. This emergency operation demonstrated WINTEX’s ability to apply engineering logistics expertise beyond project execution, providing practical support to local communities during unforeseen events. Recognition from Local Authorities and Community The swift assistance and professional execution by the WINTEX project team were met with strong appreciation from local government officials and community members. Community representatives expressed their gratitude for WINTEX’s support during a critical moment, recognizing the team’s technical capability and sense of responsibility. Committed to Long-Term Community Engagement WINTEX remains committed to its principle of “Rooted Locally, Creating Shared Value.” While delivering complex engineering and logistics projects, the company actively engages with local communities and fulfills its responsibilities as a corporate citizen. Looking ahead, WINTEX will continue to work closely with local stakeholders, contributing its expertise to support both project delivery and community resilience in the regions where it operates.

title_zh: WINTEX Logistics Corporation乔迁马尼拉BGC办公新址，持续提升工程物流服务能力
title_en: WINTEX Logistics Corporation Relocates to New Office in BGC, Strengthening Engineering Logistics Capabilities
content_zh:
日期：2025年9月10日 菲律宾·马尼拉 Wintex Logistics Corporation（以下简称 WINTEX）正式宣布，公司已于2025年9月10日乔迁至新的办公地址：菲律宾马尼拉博尼法西奥环球城（Bonifacio Global City, BGC）贸易金融大厦。此次办公地点升级，标志着WINTEX在菲律宾市场发展进程中的又一重要里程碑。 Wintex乔迁新址，持续提升服务品质 BGC作为马尼拉最具代表性的核心商务区之一，汇聚了金融机构、跨国企业及专业服务机构。新办公地点的启用，不仅为WINTEX团队提供了更加现代化、高效的办公环境，也为公司进一步整合资源、优化内部协作机制、贴近客户与合作伙伴创造了更加有利的条件。 立足长期发展，持续投入服务能力建设 此次乔迁并非简单的办公地址变更，而是WINTEX持续投资未来、夯实在菲律宾工程物流与综合物流领域服务能力的重要举措。通过升级办公环境与区位条件，公司将进一步提升在项目协调、客户响应以及跨团队协作方面的整体效率，为复杂工程项目提供更有力的支持。 以客户与项目为中心，服务能力不断深化 自成立以来，WINTEX始终致力于为客户提供可靠、高效、具竞争力的综合物流解决方案。公司深知，每一次业务拓展和能力提升，都源于客户长期以来的信任与支持。 在乔迁新址后，WINTEX将继续秉承“客户至上、服务为本”的理念，依托更优越的地理位置与升级的硬件设施，持续优化以下核心业务：
  • · 重型及大件运输与工程物流服务；
  • · 海运陆运及空运国际货运代理；
  • · 供应链管理及相关配套服务等核心业务领域。
WINTEX团队将以一贯的专业精神与责任意识，确保每一个项目在安全、时效与可控性方面满足客户与工程的实际需求。 新起点，新征程 新的办公环境，意味着新的起点。WINTEX Logistics Corporation 全体同仁期待在BGC新址继续与客户及合作伙伴携手合作，在不断变化的市场环境中，共同推动物流与工程项目的高质量交付。我们诚挚欢迎各位客户与合作伙伴莅临新址交流指导，共叙合作，共谋发展。 关于 WINTEX Logistics Corporation： WINTEX Logistics Corporation 是一家专业的综合物流服务提供商，业务涵盖重型及大件运输、工程物流、国际货运代理及供应链咨询等领域，致力于为客户提供定制化、一站式的物流解决方案，在可再生能源及大型工程项目物流领域积累了丰富经验。
content_en:
Date: September 10, 2025 Manila, Philippines WINTEX Logistics Corporation (“WINTEX”) is pleased to announce that the company officially relocated to its new office on September 10, 2025, located at the Trade and Financial Tower, Bonifacio Global City (BGC), Manila, Philippines. This relocation represents another important milestone in WINTEX’s continued development in the Philippine market. Situated in one of Manila’s premier central business districts, the new office provides a modern and efficient working environment for the WINTEX team, while also creating favorable conditions for closer engagement with clients and partners, improved internal coordination, and enhanced operational efficiency. A Strategic Step Toward Long-Term Growth The office relocation reflects WINTEX’s ongoing commitment to long-term development and continuous investment in engineering and logistics service capability enhancement. By upgrading its office location and facilities, WINTEX aims to further strengthen organizational efficiency and support the delivery of increasingly complex logistics and engineering projects across the Philippines. Client-Centered Services with Enhanced Capabilities Since its establishment, WINTEX has been dedicated to delivering reliable, efficient, and competitive integrated logistics solutions. The company recognizes that its steady progress has been made possible through the trust and long-term support of its valued clients and partners. Following the relocation, WINTEX will continue to uphold its principle of “Client First, Service Excellence,” leveraging its improved location and facilities to further enhance its core service offerings, including:
  • · Heavy-lift transportation and project logistics;
  • · International freight forwarding by sea, land, and air;
  • · Supply chain management and related support services.
With a strong focus on professionalism and execution, the WINTEX team remains committed to ensuring the safe, timely, and reliable delivery of goods, supporting clients’ project objectives with practical and effective logistics solutions. A New Chapter Begins A new office marks a new beginning. The entire WINTEX team looks forward to continuing its collaboration with clients and partners from its new location in BGC, working together to support the successful delivery of logistics and engineering projects in a dynamic and evolving market. About WINTEX Logistics Corporation: WINTEX Logistics Corporation is a professional integrated logistics service provider specializing in heavy-lift transportation, project logistics, international freight forwarding, and supply chain consulting. The company is committed to delivering customized, one-stop logistics solutions and has established a solid track record in supporting renewable energy and large-scale engineering projects.

title_zh: WINTEX顺利完成菲律宾Tanay风电项目首船设备交付，项目进入现场安装阶段
title_en: WINTEX Successfully Delivers First Shipment for the Tanay Wind Power Project in the Philippines
content_zh: 日期：2025年7月2日 菲律宾·奎松省 继菲律宾Alabat风电项目首船设备顺利交付后，WINTEX在菲律宾可再生能源工程物流领域再传捷报，成功完成Tanay风电项目首船关键设备的运输与交付，为项目建设按计划推进提供了有力支撑。 2025年7月2日凌晨5时30分，装载Tanay风电项目首批关键机组设备的“JY Cheng Rong”轮按计划抵达菲律宾因凡塔（Infanta）港外锚地。在完成联检及相关准备工作后，船舶于当日16时30分顺利完成技术要求较高的尾靠作业，安全靠泊项目临时码头。 高效协同，确保关键节点顺利衔接 在本次交付过程中，WINTEX项目团队与当地政府部门、港务机构及相关单位保持密切协同。在各方通力配合下，菲律宾海关部门于船舶靠泊当日即高效完成清关与放行手续，为后续作业创造了良好条件。 清关完成后，项目运输团队随即启动卸货作业，并于当晚正式展开设备卸载工作，确保物流各环节紧密衔接、平稳推进，最大程度保障了项目整体节奏的稳定性。 工程物流助力项目迈入关键实施阶段 Tanay风电项目首船设备的成功交付，标志着项目正式进入现场安装阶段，为后续施工计划的有序推进奠定了坚实基础。 WINTEX对菲律宾因凡塔市政府、海关及港务局在本次交付过程中给予的支持与高效协作表示诚挚感谢，同时也向项目团队及各合作伙伴在复杂工程物流条件下所展现的专业能力与责任精神致以衷心谢意。 持续以项目为中心，服务菲律宾新能源建设 作为一家专注于重型及工程物流的专业服务商，WINTEX将继续依托在重大件运输与项目物流领域积累的丰富经验，稳妥推进Tanay风电项目后续设备的运输与交付工作。 未来，WINTEX也将持续服务于菲律宾风电及其他清洁能源项目建设，以安全、高效、可执行的工程物流解决方案，助力新能源项目高质量落地。
content_en: Date: July 2, 2025 Quezon Province, Philippines Following the successful delivery of the first shipment for the Alabat Wind Power Project, WINTEX has achieved another important milestone in the Philippines by successfully completing the delivery of the first shipment of key equipment for the Tanay Wind Power Project, supporting the project’s orderly transition into the on-site installation phase. At 5:30 a.m. on July 2, 2025, the vessel “JY Cheng Rong,” carrying the first batch of critical wind turbine components for the Tanay project, arrived as scheduled at the outer anchorage of Infanta Port. After joint inspections and preparatory works were completed, the vessel successfully carried out a technically demanding stern-to mooring operation at 4:30 p.m. the same day and safely berthed at the project’s temporary terminal. Efficient Coordination Ensuring Seamless Logistics Execution Throughout the delivery process, the WINTEX project team worked in close coordination with local authorities, port operators, and relevant stakeholders. With strong cooperation from all parties, Philippine customs authorities completed clearance and release procedures on the same day of berthing. Immediately following customs clearance, the project logistics team commenced unloading operations that evening, ensuring a seamless transition between berthing, clearance, and discharge activities, and maintaining the overall stability of the project schedule. Engineering Logistics Supporting Project Progress The successful delivery of the first shipment marks the official commencement of the on-site installation phase for the Tanay Wind Power Project, laying a solid foundation for subsequent construction activities. WINTEX extends its sincere appreciation to the Infanta City Government, Philippine Customs, and the Port Authority for their strong support and efficient collaboration, and expresses heartfelt thanks to the project team and all partners for their professionalism and dedication. Committed to Advancing Renewable Energy Projects in the Philippines As a professional provider of heavy-lift and project logistics services, WINTEX will continue to leverage its extensive experience and engineering-focused logistics capabilities to ensure the safe and efficient transportation and delivery of remaining equipment for the Tanay Wind Power Project. Looking ahead, WINTEX remains committed to supporting wind power and other renewable energy projects across the Philippines, delivering reliable and executable logistics solutions that contribute to the successful implementation of clean energy infrastructure.

title_zh: WINTEX成功实施平板驳船直达运输方案 助力阿拉巴特风电项目首船设备顺利交付
title_en: WINTEX Implements Direct Flat-Deck Barge Solution, Enabling First Shipment Delivery for the Alabat Wind Power Project
content_zh: 日期：2025年4月8日 菲律宾·奎松省 WINTEX成功实施平板驳船直达运输方案 助力阿拉巴特风电项目首船设备顺利交付 2025年4月8日，WINTEX 国际工程物流团队成功完成阿拉巴特（Alabat）风电项目首船风机设备的跨国运输与靠泊作业。通过实施“中国港口—菲律宾近海”全程不换载的平板驳船直达运输方案，项目首批关键设备顺利运抵阿拉巴特临时码头，为后续现场安装工作创造了稳定条件。 以工程视角重构物流路径，回应复杂项目条件 阿拉巴特风电项目所处区域海洋环境条件复杂，全年降雨天数多、季风期间海况变化频繁，项目风机设备单机容量达8MW，塔筒及叶片尺寸大、不可拆分，对运输与靠泊条件提出了极高要求。 在项目评估阶段，WINTEX技术团队综合分析当地临时码头靠泊能力、水深条件及作业限制，确认传统重吊船或滚装船方案在该项目条件下难以实施。在此基础上，团队从工程交付目标出发，重新设计物流路径，提出并实施以平板驳船为核心的直达运输方案，从根本上减少中间换载环节，降低系统性风险。 创新工法提升执行效率，保障关键节点可控 针对临时码头作业面狭小、潮差大、作业窗口受限等客观条件，WINTEX 技术团队通过卸货模拟计算，提出“潮汐同步滚卸”作业方式。通过对驳船稳性及靠泊工况进行精细化计算与优化，将常规方案下约28天的倒泊运输周期压缩至约7天，整体物流效率提升约75%。 在每日仅约8小时的有效作业窗口内，项目团队高效组织、精准执行，在天气与海况条件允许的窗口期内，运载两套完整风力发电机组设备的“金湾时代”轮成功完成艉靠作业并安全靠泊临时码头。 首航顺利完成，为项目安装阶段奠定基础 “金湾时代”轮的成功首航与靠泊，标志着阿拉巴特风电项目大件设备跨国运输取得阶段性关键成果。2025年4月15日，随着最后一片叶片顺利卸载完成，阿拉巴特风电项目首船次中国制造风机设备全部完成交付，并实现重件海运领域“零滞期”的高质量执行目标。 以项目成功为导向的工程物流实践 此次运输任务的顺利完成，得益于WINTEX项目团队的系统策划、船方的专业操作，以及现场各方的高效协同。WINTEX对所有参与首航作业的合作伙伴及现场人员表示诚挚感谢。 作为一家专注于重型及工程物流的专业服务商，WINTEX将持续以工程可行性与项目交付目标为核心，不断优化物流组织方式，助力可再生能源及大型工程项目在复杂环境下稳步推进。
content_en: Date: April 8, 2025 Quezon Province, Philippines WINTEX Successfully Implements Direct Flat-Deck Barge Solution for First Shipment Delivery of the Alabat Wind Power Project On April 8, 2025, WINTEX successfully completed the delivery and berthing of the first shipment of wind turbine equipment for the Alabat Wind Power Project. By implementing a direct flat-deck barge transportation solution from China ports to offshore Philippines without transshipment, the project’s initial critical equipment was safely delivered to the Alabat temporary terminal, supporting the project’s transition toward the installation phase. Engineering-oriented logistics addressing challenging project conditions The Alabat Wind Power Project is located in an area characterized by complex marine conditions, frequent rainfall, and seasonal monsoon impacts. The wind turbine equipment, with a unit capacity of 8 MW and oversized tower sections and nearly 90-meter blades, posed significant challenges for transportation and berthing operations. Following a comprehensive assessment of the temporary terminal’s berthing capacity, water depth, and operational constraints, WINTEX’s technical team determined that conventional heavy-lift or Ro-Ro vessel solutions were not feasible. The logistics strategy was redesigned from an engineering delivery perspective, centering on a flat-deck barge solution to minimize intermediate handling steps and reduce overall execution risk. Innovative methodology enhancing execution efficiency To address limited working space, tidal variations, and restricted operational windows at the temporary terminal, WINTEX introduced a “tide-synchronized roll-on/roll-off” methodology. Through detailed simulations and optimization of barge stability and berthing conditions, the average turnaround time per voyage was reduced from approximately 28 days under conventional approaches to about 7 days, yielding an estimated 75% improvement in logistics efficiency. Despite a daily unloading window of only around 8 hours, the WINTEX project team executed operations with precision and efficiency. Under favorable weather and sea conditions, the vessel “Jin Wan Shi Dai,” carrying two complete sets of wind turbine equipment, successfully completed a stern-to-berth operation and safely docked at the Alabat temporary terminal. Maiden voyage completed, supporting project installation The successful maiden voyage and berthing of the “Jin Wan Shi Dai” represent a major milestone in the transportation of oversized equipment for the Alabat Wind Power Project. On April 15, 2025, with the unloading of the final blade completed, the first shipment of China-manufactured wind turbine equipment was fully delivered via flat-deck barge, achieving zero demurrage during execution. Engineering logistics in support of project delivery The successful execution of this operation was made possible through meticulous planning by the WINTEX project team, professional vessel operations, and close coordination among all on-site stakeholders. WINTEX extends its sincere appreciation to all teams and partners involved in the maiden voyage. As a professional provider of heavy-lift and project logistics services, WINTEX remains committed to delivering reliable, engineering-driven logistics solutions that support the successful implementation of renewable energy and large-scale infrastructure projects under complex operating conditions.
